description.value: Broad Street Cycles is a long-standing premium bike shop anchored in downtown Victoria, recently merged with Bici under CSL Sports Ltd. while retaining its name, team, and both locations. The Broad Street flagship stocks Specialized and other premium brands and operates a dedicated service department, while a second location beside Jordie Lunn Bike Park in Langford houses MTB service, bike rentals, and a demo centre.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 66m; shed (covered, secure) at 72m. Total: 6 spaces.

Bike rentals are explicitly advertised ('RENT A BIKE AT JORDIE LUNN BIKE PARK') but tied to the Langford location, not the Broad Street OSM record.
